notes: Safety Tracker v2.10.69 CLEAN final correction. User setup now assigns POSITIONS rather than multiple departments. Each Admin-defined position belongs to one department; a user can hold multiple active positions for cross-training, with exactly one Main/Default position. The user's effective department requirements are derived automatically from all positions they hold, so department training audiences continue to work without manually assigning several departments. Whole-hotel requirements remain one Everyone assignment and are not duplicated by department. Existing legacy department membership is preserved until positions are assigned; once a user is saved with positions, old manual department selections are cleared and effective departments are rebuilt from those positions. Training frequency for new training defaults to six months but remains fully Manager/Admin editable per training item. Annual controlled-document review and manager-change / accident-incident / significant-change review triggers remain. No positions or responsibility holders are pre-created.
